characterList.description: A young man with short, blonde hair, wearing a white t-shirt with a graphic design and black and white patterned pants. He is sitting on a chair playing a blue electric guitar.
characterList.name: Guitarist

content_metadata.description: A comprehensive guitar tutorial focusing on major 9, major 7, minor 9, minor 7, and minor 11 chords, explaining their uses in songwriting.

qAndA.question: Why does the guitarist say the A major 7 chord sounds "jazzy"?

qAndA.answer: He uses his thumb to mute the sixth string while fretting the chord.

activities.description: Plays a C major 9 chord and explains the chord's name.
Demonstrates the "flair" of major 9 chords and plays an F major 9 chord.
Explains how to use major 9 chords in songwriting and plays a chord progression example.
Introduces the following section of the tutorial and mentions a website with exercise package.

Demonstrates minor 7 chord voicings, using D minor 7 and A minor 7.
Plays one voicing for A minor 11 and explains he likes using it.
